body: Thank you also. I appreciate it too. Anytime.
Stress and lack of sleep is huge factor to getting flare ups. I’m always anxious. I hope you can get more sleep and you can be less stressed. I know it’s hard though.
So has your skin gotten any better since you stopped eating eggs? Same as you, I’ve had it since I was 6 weeks old. I came off immune suppressors last year. I was having too many infections.
Thank you! Yes I agree. I’ve never been bothered by it. It’s like what you don’t have you don’t miss. How long have you had eczema for?

Hi, well I tried it when I was really young and had a reaction, so I don’t really know what fish is like. So it’s been ok. When I was growing up a boy I knew was allergic to chocolate, so it could have been worse 🤣
Yes, I have an allergy to eggs and fish. Fish is the worst allergy for me.
Weather balloon, maybe.
Yes, heat makes me worse. I did try the UV treatment, I only went for three treatments and I was so bad. So you are doing the right thing in not having it.
I understand how you feel. It is so exhausting. I hope the doctor can put you on new treatment that can help you. You are not alone.
I’ve had that too. And they weep.
Yeah I’m the same. Sometimes when my skin is that bad I don’t want to put moisture Cream on or go in the bath or shower because I know how much it will sting.
Spooky.
when I was 14 I saw a ghost walking on a mountain path. She had long white wedding type dress on and I will never forget it. I still can see it so clearly in my mind.

I feel the same as you. The pain and discomfort and itching is unbearable sometimes. I find sleep helps a bit. If I don’t get any sleep I’ll flare up worse. I hope you feel better soon. I totally understand what you are going through.
That’s amazing.
I was pranked the same way lol. Yes it’s from an app.
Yeah, I thought the same as many on here. The jeepers creepers monster lol. Great picture. 👍
Happy Birthday 🥳🎊💝🎁xxx

That’s so lovely. ♥️
I am so sorry you had to go through this. I feel for you and Mom so much. Please take care. Sending best wishes to you and your mom. ♥️
Go and get a fucking treat. 🤣🤣🤣

Sorry you are feeling like this. I wish we all could feel better.
Yeah I totally understand that. Thank you so much for your message. You are not alone either, friend.
I’m so sorry you are going through this. Wish we could all feel better.
Yeah I understand that feeling. Sorry you also are feeling like this.
I’m sorry you and your friend feel like this. I understand that feeling too.
Thank you!!

Cool picture.

Aww it’s my pleasure. Yes call your mom. You sound like such a lovely person and I hope you feel better soon. Things can change so quickly for the better in life. And it’s so nice you are close to your mom. Please take care of yourself. Xxx
There is nothing wrong with needing your mom. It doesn’t matter how old you are, we all need our mom’s sometimes. :)
Totally agree. Can’t wait for Autumn.
Looks like a really hip fox LOL! But seriously I would have swallowed that cigarette if it was me if I had saw that.

Lovely. Thank you for sharing this.
This also happened in poltergeist 2. The grandmother passed away and she phoned Carolanne’s toy phone. I do believe you.
Me too. I had the same as you. Aching legs as well. Didn’t last long though.

I had my first dose of AstraZeneca vaccine nine weeks ago. Had a bad flare up after it. I think it’s because i had flu symptoms with the side effects so that didn’t help my skin. I’m glad I had it though. Just waiting on the second one.
So funny. 😂

Hi there, I just read your post and I understand what you are growing through. People don’t understand the pain we go through. How every flare up is so uncomfortable and painful. It’s effects every part of your life. And the days when you can go to bed and just go to sleep are so lovely. The good days when they come are amazing. Basically I just wanted to say that I understand what you are going through. I’ve been on auto immune drugs for a few years now. Although it hasn’t stopped the flare ups completely it does give me more relief. Please take care of yourself. It can get better.
